author: Swinhoe, 1866
habitat: 야산, 풀밭, 해안가, 섬 등 여러 환경

months.note: 겨울에는 북쪽에서 내려온 무리가 모여 겨울을 난다.

summary: 전국에서 흔히 번식하는 텃새이며, 겨울에는 북쪽에서 내려온 무리가 모여 월동하는 흔한 겨울철새이기도 하다. 예전에는 흔한 겨울철새였으나 1960년대 이후 전국에서 흔히 번식하는 텃새로 자리를 잡았다. 야산, 풀밭, 해안가, 섬 등 여러 환경에서 번식한다. 시베리아 동남부, 몽골, 중국, 인도, 동남아시아, 한국, 대만, 일본에 산다.

sexes.male: 암컷과 비슷하나 위꼬리덮깃과 아래꼬리덮깃이 더 어두운 흑갈색이고 뺨이 더 밝아 보인다.
sexes.female: 수컷과 비슷하나 꼬리덮깃이 덜 어둡고 뺨이 덜 밝아 보인다.

art.subject: Eastern Spot-billed Duck (Anas zonorhyncha), adult, as seen in Korea all year: crown dark brown; face, cheeks and foreneck pale buff, crossed by a dark eye-stripe and a second dark stripe across the lower cheek; neck and body dark brown, the breast and flank feathers with slightly paler fringes, so the body looks uniformly dark against the pale face; tertials with white outer webs, showing as a white patch at the rear of the folded wing; blue speculum; tail and undertail coverts blackish-brown. Bill black with a broad yellow tip; dark eye; orange legs and feet.
art.pose: swimming on calm water, side view
art.scene: Korean coastal grassland at the foot of a low wooded hill, a calm pool along the shore; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on a bank: dark brown body, pale buff face with a dark eye-stripe and cheek stripe, black bill with a yellow tip, white tertial patch at the rear of the folded wing, orange legs
adult in flight seen from above: dark brown body and wings, blue speculum, white tertials, pale buff face, black yellow-tipped bill, head, body and tail in a straight line
adult male, rear detail in side view: blackish-brown upper and undertail coverts, darker than the female's, and paler cheeks
art.build: Large dabbling duck, about 61cm, the size of a Mallard and similar in shape: heavy body, rounded head, medium neck, sitting high on the water. Bill long and broad, about as long as the head, straight. Legs short, orange. Tail short and slightly pointed. In flight the blue speculum and white tertials show at long range, and the white underwing contrasts with the dark body.
avoid: Do not paint a red spot at the base of the bill — that is Indian Spot-billed Duck; the Korean bird has an all-black bill with a yellow tip.
Do not paint a green head, white neck ring or curled tail feathers (Mallard drake).
Do not paint the bill all yellow or orange.
Do not paint a pale, scaly brown body like a female Mallard; it is dark brown against a pale face.
